text_en: To the leader. A Maskil of the Korahites.
text_cn: 科辣黑后裔的训诲歌， 交与乐官。

text_en: As a deer longs for flowing streams, so my soul longs for you, O God.
text_cn: 天主，我的灵魂渴慕你， 真好像牝鹿渴慕溪水。

text_en: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and behold the face of God?
text_cn: 我的灵魂渴念天主，生活的天主， 我何时来，能把天主的仪容目睹？

text_en: My tears have been my food day and night, while people say to me continually, “Where is your God? ”
text_cn: 有人终日向我说：“你的天主在哪里？” 我的眼泪竟变成了我昼夜的饮食。

text_en: These things I remember, as I pour out my soul: how I went with the throng, and led them in procession to the house of God, with glad shouts and songs of thanksgiving, a multitude keeping festival.
text_cn: 我想起昔日周旋在欢乐的群众里， 在群众欢呼赞颂的歌声里， 领他们朝觐（jìn）天主的圣殿时， 我的心不免感到忧伤哀悲，

text_en: Why are you cast down, O my soul, and why are you disquieted within me? Hope in God; for I shall again praise him, my help
text_cn: 我的灵魂，你为何悲伤，为何忧苦？ 期望天主！因为我还要向他颂祝， 因为他是我的救援，是我的天主。

text_en: and my God. My soul is cast down within me; therefore I remember you from the land of Jordan and of Hermon, from Mount Mizar.
text_cn: 我自约但地，从赫尔孟山，由小丘陵， 一想起你来，我的灵魂即惴惴不宁。

text_en: Deep calls to deep at the thunder of your cataracts; all your waves and your billows have gone over me.
text_cn: 在你瀑布的巨声下，深渊与深渊和唱； 你所有的洪涛巨浪，都冲击在我身上。

text_en: By day the Lord commands his steadfast love, and at night his song is with me, a prayer to the God of my life.
text_cn: 但愿上主在白昼颁赐他的恩爱慈惠， 我夜间向赐我生命的天主歌颂赞美！

text_en: I say to God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why must I walk about mournfully because the enemy oppresses me? ”
text_cn: 我对天主说：我的磐石，你为什么将我遗忘？ 为什么我应常在仇人的压迫下徘徊沮丧？

text_en: As with a deadly wound in my body, my adversaries taunt me, while they say to me continually, “Where is your God? ”
text_cn: 我仇敌欺凌我时，我觉得痛入骨髓， 他们终日对我说：“你的天主在哪里？”

text_en: Why are you cast down, O my soul, and why are you disquieted within me? Hope in God; for I shall again praise him, my help and my God.
text_cn: 我的灵魂，你为何悲伤，为何忧苦？ 期望天主！因为我还要向他颂祝， 因为他是我的救援，是我的天主。
